cost_note: All arms receive both learned scores; shared production includes both model runs. Decision time is additional.
limitations: Merged six-predictor enzyme claims (clean, dpz, enzbert, graphec, mapred, topec) after a uniform raw-score floor (raw_score >= 0.05); ec6c adds Swiss-Prot DIAMOND contract claims.
Contract-v3 learned models score only candidates carrying a predictor contract and abstain elsewhere; measured, not assumed.
Price genomes are a reannotation benchmark, not a random genome sample.
Unknown truth is not a negative.
Repeated case decisions are clustered within genome; counts are case-level.
